_readme: US-2817: the SHARED behavioural fixture for the title-sync ORCHESTRATION.
title-sync-cases.json already pins the substitution half against its two copies. This
file does the same job one layer up, for buildTitleSyncPatch — the decisions wrapped
around the substitution: refuse an eBay-origin listing, move both A/B variants, flag a
hand-edited or live title instead of rewriting it silently, and return an EMPTY patch
There was one copy (src/lib/title-sync-patch.ts) until US-2817 added the edge one, and
the edge copy exists because bulk re-identify is the first edge writer that replaces an
OLD field value with a NEW one. Two copies with no shared assertion is how the
substitution half drifted before, so this went in with the second copy rather than after.
src/lib/__tests__/title-sync-patch.test.ts. Add a case here, not to one suite.

buildTitleSyncPatch.name: substitutes the changed field into the title
refuses to touch an ebay-origin listing
leaves a non-string variant entry untouched instead of crashing
flags a hand-edited title for review rather than silently rewriting it

input.baseTitle: Patagonia Fleece Jacket RARE vintage colourway

expected.listing_title: Arc'teryx Fleece Jacket RARE vintage colourway

buildTitleSyncPatch.name: does not flag when the title still matches the AI snapshot
flags a live listing because buyers already see that title
empty patch when the old value is not in the title
empty patch when there are no changes
empty patch when there is no base title
empty patch when a size widens into a value containing the old one
a size change moves the size token without touching XL-like words

input.baseTitle: Nike Windrunner Jacket Size L Long Sleeve

expected.listing_title: Nike Windrunner Jacket Size XL Long Sleeve
